links.comparator_used: Physician-only decision-making (AI-only arm also included in the design, but its result is not reported in the abstract)
links.outcome: Clinical decision quality score and decision time across 5 TCM cases
links.effect: Quality 33.62 vs 28.97 (16.1% improvement; P<.001); time 162.6 s vs 479.2 s (66.1% reduction; P<.001); adoption of AI suggestions 74.25%, modification 24%, rejection 1.75%
links.quote: Human-AI collaboration achieved significant improvements compared with physician-only decision-making, with 16.1% quality enhancement (33.62 vs 28.97; P<.001) and 66.1% time reduction (162.6 s vs 479.2 s; P<.001).

design_hint: human-AI collaboration (clinician review of LLM output)
